d: Manage governance committee operations and administration to ensure effective decision-making, compliance with governance frameworks, and the efficient execution of committee responsibilities.
Oversee committee governance processes, documentation, meeting management, action tracking, and stakeholder coordination while ensuring adherence to organizational policies and governance standards.
Support organizational governance effectiveness through robust committee management, reporting, and continuous improvement initiatives.
q: Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Corporate Governance, Law, Public Administration, Finance, Management, or a related field.
CGI/ICSA Governance Qualification, GRCP, PMP, or equivalent professional certification preferred.
6–10 years of experience in governance, corporate secretariat, committee management, compliance, executive administration, or related disciplines.
Managing governance committees, executive forums, or board-related activities.
Preparing governance documentation, committee submissions, minutes, and action trackers.
Supporting governance frameworks, policy implementation, and organizational governance initiatives.
Coordinating with senior executives, committee members, and business stakeholders.
Supporting governance audits, compliance reviews, and governance reporting activities.
r: Manage the planning, scheduling, and administration of governance committees and related governance forums.
Oversee the preparation, review, quality assurance, and distribution of committee agendas, reports, presentations, and supporting materials.
Ensure committee submissions comply with governance requirements, approval protocols, documentation standards, and established procedures.
Coordinate committee meetings and ensure timely circulation of meeting packs, resolutions, and governance communications.
Oversee the preparation and review of meeting minutes, action logs, decision registers, and governance records.
Monitor and track committee actions, decisions, and resolutions to ensure timely completion and accountability across business functions.
Provide governance advice and support to stakeholders regarding committee processes, documentation requirements, and governance expectations.
Maintain governance frameworks, committee charters, terms of reference, and governance documentation repositories.
Prepare governance reports, committee performance metrics, dashboards, and management updates for leadership review.
Identify governance risks, process gaps, and opportunities for improvement and recommend appropriate corrective actions.
Support governance audits, compliance reviews, and assurance activities related to committee operations and governance practices.
Lead and develop governance coordinators, analysts, or support staff while promoting governance best practices and continuous improvement.

d: Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we’re unlocking new possibilities as one global team.

Join us in our mission to transform the way people shop and eat, where impact, innovation, and growth drives everything we do. Our Commercial team sits at the centre of Deliveroo’s marketplace - shaping how we serve restaurants, grocers, and new verticals worldwide. From negotiating key partnerships to unlocking new revenue streams and crafting data-led growth strategies, we take on big challenges that move the business forward. If you thrive in fast-paced, commercial environments and want to influence the future of a global brand - this is the team for you.

As Deliveroo continues to scale, we become a major revenue channel for restaurants - aside from providing best-in-class support, we are restaurant consultants that use data-driven insight and industry knowledge to help our partner restaurants grow. Our account management team owns and manages restaurant relationships. We are restaurant consultants who use data-driven analytics and industry knowledge to provide best-in-class support and strategic value to our restaurant partners. The Account Managers are a passionate, dynamic group of team players who work well together and cross-functionally with other departments, and of course, they’re fun, personable, and great at building exceptional relationships.

As an Account Manager, you will manage a portfolio of restaurant partners on Deliveroo, with a focus on high-performing Local Gems and selected national chains. These partners play an important role in attracting customers to the marketplace and represent strong growth opportunities for Deliveroo. You will work closely with your partners to improve operational performance, drive marketing initiatives, and identify opportunities to grow their business on the Deliveroo platform. You will also collaborate with internal teams across marketing, operations, and commercial functions to ensure partners deliver a strong customer experience while achieving sustainable growth.
q: Our ideal candidate will bring strong expertise in some of these areas and curiosity to grow in others:
Minimum of 3-5 years of experience in a commercial role in a fast-paced environment
Commercial mindset with the ability to identify growth opportunities
Very data-conversant with an ability to utilise and analyse data to tell a story
Great organisational skills with excellent team-player qualities
Strong relationship management and stakeholder engagement skills
Problem-solving mindset and ability to navigate operational challenges
Enjoy working in a constantly evolving environment
Demonstrate strong competency using Microsoft Office tools and related project/program management applications to drive best practices
Strong knowledge of the restaurant industry is a plus
Fluency in English and Arabic is a must
r: Manage a portfolio of Deliveroo's restaurants in Kuwait, including high-sales volume drivers and global restaurant brands. You will maintain and grow relationships with these partners.

Lead the delivery agenda with your partners to ensure they are operating with excellent fundamentals, and define and execute joint initiatives that drive sustainable growth for both Deliveroo and your partners.

Lead the day-to-day management of your accounts, interacting primarily with stakeholders who manage daily projects or operations. You will work on negotiations and longer-term account plans in collaboration with your Restaurant Partner.
Monitor operational metrics and support partners in improving service quality
Drive adoption of Deliveroo marketing tools, promotions, and campaigns
Support partner onboarding and expansion onto the Deliveroo platform
Demonstrate the ability to resolve day-to-day issues and problem-solve independently, seeking advice for more complex problems when necessary
Work cross-functionally with other departments (Marketing, Operations) to lead new projects and drive initiatives forward
